  <Metadata description="Intentionally perturbed source-derived procedure; experimental outcome not observed." publication="https://huggingface.co/datasets/open-reaction-database/ord-data/resolve/b6c89761dacf809d4082acbdbebe72042a08db91/data/99/ord_dataset-99c23cf435dc42f1af884053bc8b11c7.parquet" reaction_class="borylation"/>
  <Hardware>
    <!--Analysis binding: {"component": "column", "params": {}, "verified": false, "wetted_materials": null}-->
    <Component id="column" type="column"/>
    <!--Analysis binding: {"component": "product", "params": {}, "verified": false, "wetted_materials": null}-->
    <Component id="product" type="reactor"/>
    <!--Analysis binding: {"component": "reactor", "params": {"T_max_C": null, "T_min_C": null, "capacity_mL": 50, "pressure_max_bar": null}, "verified": false, "wetted_materials": ["borosilicate_glass"]}-->
    <Component id="reactor" type="reactor"/>
  </Hardware>
  <Reagents>
    <!--r1: C[OH2+].C[OH2+].C1CC=CCCC=C1.C1CC=CCCC=C1.[Ir].[Ir]-->
    <Reagent name="r1" role="catalyst"/>
    <!--r2: [K].OC(C)(C)C-->
    <Reagent name="r2" role="catalyst"/>
    <!--r3: O1B(OC(C)(C)C1(C)C)B2OC(C)(C)C(O2)(C)C-->
    <Reagent name="r3" role="reagent"/>
    <!--r4: O=C1C=CC=2C=CC=C(C3=CN=C(C=C3)C=4N=CC=CC4)C2N1-->
    <Reagent name="r4" role="reagent"/>
    <!--r5: O1CCCC1-->
    <Reagent name="r5" role="solvent"/>
    <!--r6: O=C(C=1OC=CC1)N(C(C)C)C(C)C-->
    <Reagent name="r6" role="substrate"/>
  </Reagents>
  <Procedure>
    <!--Analysis context: {"pressure_control": "SEALED", "reflux": false}-->
    <!--Pressure-control context: SEALED-->
    <!--In an argon filled glove box-->
    <!--Atmosphere context (no purge operation inferred): argon; environment-->
    <!--[Ir(cod)(OMe)]2-->
    <Add vessel="reactor" reagent="r1" amount="0.003 mmol"/>
    <!--L1 ligand-->
    <Add vessel="reactor" reagent="r4" amount="0.007 mmol"/>
    <!--B2pin2-->
    <Add vessel="reactor" reagent="r3" amount="0.2 mmol"/>
    <!--KOtBu-->
    <Add vessel="reactor" reagent="r2" amount="0.009 mmol"/>
    <!--dry THF-->
    <Add vessel="reactor" reagent="r5" amount="1 mL"/>
    <!--The reaction mixture was stirred for 2 minutes at room temperature.-->
    <Stir vessel="reactor" time="120 s"/>
    <!--N,N-diisopropylfuran-2-carboxamide-->
    <Add vessel="reactor" reagent="r6" amount="0.2 mmol"/>
    <!--The microreactor was capped with a teflon pressure cap and placed into pre-heated aluminum block at 80 oC. The reaction mixture was stirred for 12 h.-->
    <HeatChill vessel="reactor" temp="80 °C" time="43200 s" stir="true"/>
    <!--THF was removed under reduced pressure-->
    <Evaporate vessel="reactor"/>
    <!--chromatographic separation with silica gel (10% ethyl acetate in hexane as eluent)-->
    <RunColumn from_vessel="reactor" to_vessel="product" column="column"/>
  </Procedure>
</Synthesis>
